label: In the stipulated Kripke semantics, omission of every indexed selection of at…, by Direct-proof
meaning: Construct successor witnesses and restrict the bound. Reuse the existing Alternating.checks individual-contingency conjunct for bound 1; refute its bound 2 by enumerating the Boolean candidates. Enumerate the three rigid singleton populations to omit each pair, and use every-world population to refute whole-roster absence and bound 3. The proof is structural and may fail for another profile; it is not a transcription.
